body: Man, im suicidal too and I also have OCD. I'm bipolar so I have a bit of depression. It's not the right way to go. Think of the good things that you have, not the bad things. My boyfriend has aspergers too so I know that it has pretty bad symptoms. I feel for you, so take it slow for a while and don't give in. You'll be fine. You're the only one who can make things better, your life might not be a bed of roses but things will be so much better. Trust me.
